caption: The drawing depicts a detailed bonnet, primarily colored in shades of deep burgundy and pink. The main body of the bonnet is a solid burgundy color, with textured feather-like decorations matching the main hue on the side. The interior of the bonnet is adorned with a cluster of pink flowers and green leaves, set against a background of delicate white lace. A large, wide ribbon in a muted pink shade is tied into a bow at the chin, with long, flowing ends trimmed with scalloped edges. To the right of the main image, there are two smaller outline sketches of the bonnet, one showing the profile view and the other showing the front view, both rendered in line drawing without color. The background is a plain, light tan color with a few small random splashes of yellowish-orange pigment to the left of the bonnet.
title: Bonnet
